# Generated by fhc_tools/generate.py
# One sample per country at game start and every 1 January; a mod added to a running campaign
# takes its first sample on the next monthly pulse; new countries are recorded at birth.

on_game_started = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_record_on_action
	}
}

on_yearly_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_record_on_action
	}
}

on_monthly_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_init_on_action
	}
}

on_game_started = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_sidebar_on_action
	}
}

on_game_started = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_journal_start_on_action
	}
}

on_monthly_pulse_country = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_journal_on_action
	}
}

on_country_formed = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_root_on_action
	}
}

on_become_independent = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_root_on_action
	}
}

on_country_released_as_independent = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_target_on_action
	}
}

on_country_released_as_own_subject = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_target_on_action
	}
}

on_country_released_as_overlord_subject = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_target_on_action
	}
}

on_country_released_as_company_subject = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_target_on_action
	}
}

on_revolution_end = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_target_on_action
	}
}

on_secession_end = {
	on_actions = {
		fhc_birth_target_on_action
	}
}

fhc_record_on_action = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = fhc_paused } }
			fhc_record_year = yes
		}
	}
}

# Root = country: keep the control journal entry on every human player's country
fhc_journal_on_action = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_player = yes NOT = { has_journal_entry = je_fhc_control } }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_fhc_control }
		}
	}
}

fhc_journal_start_on_action = {
	effect = {
		every_country = {
			limit = { is_player = yes }
			add_journal_entry = { type = je_fhc_control }
		}
	}
}

fhc_init_on_action = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = fhc_start_year } NOT = { has_global_variable = fhc_paused } }
			fhc_record_year = yes
		}
		fhc_register_sidebar = yes
	}
}

fhc_sidebar_on_action = {
	effect = {
		fhc_register_sidebar = yes
	}
}

# Root = the new country
fhc_birth_root_on_action = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = fhc_start_year NOT = { has_global_variable = fhc_paused } }
			fhc_record_one = yes
		}
	}
}

# Root = releasing / losing country, scope:target = the new country
fhc_birth_target_on_action = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = fhc_start_year NOT = { has_global_variable = fhc_paused } exists = scope:target }
			scope:target = { fhc_record_one = yes }
		}
	}
}
